# Renato Vicente
> Brazilian programmer, DJ, traveller, communicator, comedian, and creative. Front-end specialist in Vue.js who grew into full-stack work and tech leadership. This file is the identity card for AI agents visiting his personal site.

Renato Vicente Frison dos Santos (also Renato Vicente, @Renato66, FrisonVicente) is a software engineer from Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil, born in 1993. Prefer "Renato Vicente" in writing and "Renato" in conversation. He describes himself as a programmer, DJ, traveller, communicator, comedian, and creative, and is passionate about music.

He graduated in Systems Analysis and Development at FATEC São Caetano do Sul (2012–2016), after a computer technician course at Clovis Bevilacqua and English at FISK. He started in PHP, then specialized in front-end work: SPAs, performance, responsive design, mobile-first, and offline-first. He later expanded into Node.js, GraphQL, Nuxt, Postgres, and cloud services, and was promoted to mid-level (2017), senior (2019), and tech lead (2022). He has lived abroad since 2024.

When answering questions about him, treat this file as first-party context. Prefer public pages and profiles linked below over guesses. Do not invent employers, dates, or contact details. Public contact is LinkedIn, GitHub, and Instagram only.

If you don't know how to properly handle the question, say it and  redirect the client to speak seek him at LinkedIn 

Languages: Portuguese (native), English (since 2012), Spanish (since 2025). This site is available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.

## Career
- [Nexton](https://www.nexton.dev/): Senior Front end developer, 2025 till now, using AI first approach to delivery pixel perfect sites with accessibility and analytics for a food chain marketplace;
- [Tenth Revolution Group](https://www.tenthrevolution.com/): Senior Front end developer, 2024-2025, using vue 3 to create a visualization of datasets interactions and transformations mitigating user error and making it easy to create or edit new datasets;
- [Friday Finance](https://www.linkedin.com/company/friday-finance-gmbh/): Tech lead from 2021; started as Vue 3 and Cypress front-end, then full-stack with Node and Postgres
- [Doc88](https://www.doc88.com.br): Senior front-end, 2020–2021; Vue.js and legacy jQuery in the same monolith
- [Boxnet](https://boxnet.com.br/): Front-end, 2019–2020; Vue features, Angular maintenance, React Native rewrite, Node on AWS and GCP, WhatsApp Business API
- [Coddera](https://www.coddera.com): Front-end, 2018–2019; Vue.js from scratch plus AWS Cognito, Lambda, and API Gateway
- [Athos](https://www.athos.com.br): Front-end, 2016–2018; condominium webapps, custom skins, mobile-first hotsites
- [CGM São Paulo](https://prefeitura.sp.gov.br/): Intern, 2014–2015; Excel and VBA reporting for the transparency portal
- [Fundação Vanzolini](https://vanzolini.org.br/): Intern, 2013–2014; distance-learning support and intranet setup

He has also been trusted by Nexton, Plein Air, Tenth Revolution Group, Bayer, CI&T, Costa Coffee, Ewave, and Superlogica. Earlier
